title: MIMO Independent Pixel Audit of All 15 F0-25E Screenshots
auditor: MiMo (independent; personal inspection of every PNG, no reliance on Anti's descriptions)
method: Direct visual inspection of raw/screenshots/frame_0000.png through frame_0014.png, cross-checked against raw/world_frames.jsonl (stage_hint, foreground, astra_windows, window_count), F0_25E_UI_AUDIT.json, and F0_25E_FINAL_REPORT.md section 5.

global_observations.foreground_all_frames: Antigravity.exe (AI IDE, maximized, rect [-7,-7,1543,823] per world_frames)
global_observations.window_count_world_frames: 14 at EVERY frame including baseline (before AstraRun.exe was spawned) - the launcher never added a visible top-level window
global_observations.taskbar_note: Taskbar identical across all frames; the stylized 'A' icon at ~x=1404 belongs to Antigravity (matches Antigravity sidebar logo), present at baseline before AstraRun started - not evidence of Astra UI
global_observations.visible_non_astra_activity: Antigravity 'Background Task Output' panel shows pytest results (91 passed); conversation feed shows Antigravity-agent messages about rebuilding AstraRun binary and launching the F0-25E observer; from frame_0002 onward the goal panel lists '.venv\Scripts\python scripts/f0_25e_observer.py' as a running task

entries.pixels_show: Antigravity fullscreen: conversation 'PHASE F0-25E - TRUST NOTHING...' + pytest background output; goal panel '1 active goal: F0-25E - Replace the compromised dogfood acceptance harness...'; observer task NOT yet listed as running
entries.notes: Clock 8:45 PM 10/11/2026. Baseline precedes AstraRun spawn (~20:45:39 per production log). No Astra expected yet.

entries.pixels_show: Identical Antigravity scene; goal panel shows '1 task running, 1 active goal' (F0-25E goal only); NO Astra launcher anywhere, including the (448,48) region where Astra's production log claims the launcher was presented and INTERACTIVE at 20:45:44.8
entries.disagreement_detail: stage_hint asserts LAUNCHER_OPEN; pixels show no launcher; astra_windows=[]; window_count=14 (same as baseline). Production log (corroborating, outside frozen pkg) claims launcher vis=True act=True focus=True state=INTERACTIVE at this timestamp - direct three-way tension: label says open, Astra self-log says visible, pixels+enumeration say absent.

entries.pixels_show: Antigravity scene; goal panel now lists '.venv\Scripts\python scripts/f0_25e_observer.py' as running task; NO Astra launcher, NO populated query field visible anywhere
entries.disagreement_detail: stage_hint asserts REQUEST_POPULATED; no query UI on screen; capture is ~1s after frame_0001 and coincides with IPC SUBMIT_QUERY window (20:45:45.93).

cross_document_disagreements.pixel_reality: No launcher, no query UI, no deliverable presentation visible in those frames
cross_document_disagreements.classification: CONTRADICTED (stage_hint is an observer-assigned expectation, not an observed state)

cross_document_disagreements.claim: UI presentation stacking was fixed: AstraRun launcher is HWND_TOPMOST, rendering visibly on the desktop
cross_document_disagreements.pixel_reality: 0/15 frames show any Astra window; enumeration shows none either

cross_document_disagreements.claim: All 15 frames foreground Antigravity.exe, astra_launcher_visible=false, astra_hud_visible=false
cross_document_disagreements.pixel_reality: Matches personal inspection on all 15 frames

cross_document_disagreements.source: AstraRun production log (corroborating, outside frozen package)
cross_document_disagreements.claim: Launcher presented at (448,48), state=INTERACTIVE, vis=True, act=True at 20:45:43.99-20:45:45.18
cross_document_disagreements.pixel_reality: frame_0001 (20:45:44.8) and frame_0002 (20:45:45.9) show no launcher at (448,48) or anywhere

verdict: All 15 screenshots are honest Antigravity captures with honest false Astra-visibility fields in the UI audit. Screenshot MISLABELING of the F0-25D.1 type is fixed at the UI-audit level; residual mislabeling persists in world_frames stage_hints (LAUNCHER_OPEN/REQUEST_POPULATED/DELIVERABLES_PRODUCED labels do not describe frame content).
